program.name: V2 · ยืนตรง / โปรแกรมใหม่
program.description: ท่ายืนตรงของหุ่น 16 แกน

assumptions: 16 DS3225 servo envelopes, 60 g each; frames use aluminium density 2700 kg/m3.
Concept geometry: housing/lug envelopes, no validated fasteners, wiring or full joint sweep.
Masses, motor operating torque and contact friction require measurement.
No active yaw axis or actuated toe/heel; not a replica of PRIMER-V5 or a full UVC implementation.
